data.name: Naimul
data.gender_notes: Naimul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Naimul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Naimitra' which means friend and 'Mool' which means root or source. The name Naimul signifies a radiant and powerful individual who is a source of inspiration and strength to his friends and loved ones. The name Naimul carries the meaning “Radiant Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Naimul usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Naimul is a Sanskrit name that signifies a friend of the divine. It is believed that individuals with this name are blessed with the divine grace and have a strong spiritual connection.
data.etymology: Naimul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naimul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
